title: Matibag seeks to remove prosecutor from handling Paolo Duterte case

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag will file a motion for inhibition on Monday against the Davao City prosecutor handling the libel and cyberlibel complaints recently filed by Davao City First District Rep. Paolo Duterte. In an interview on Monday, Matibag said they had learned that the prosecutor is a first cousin of Honeylet Avanceña, the common-law partner of former President Rodrigo Duterte.
